titles.title: Collaborative Combat Aircraft Sustainment and Readiness Assessment Act of 2026
Collaborative Combat Aircraft Sustainment and Readiness Assessment Act of 2026

To direct the Secretary of the Air Force, in consultation with the Commander of United States Transportation Command to submit a report on storage and sustainment plans for autonomous, uncrewed collaborative combat aircraft of the Department of the Air Force, and for other purposes.

action.text: Referred to the House Committee on Armed Services.
